title: Illustration Master Class Enrollment Opens
content: Rebecca Guay has just announced that enrollment for the Illustration Master Class 2010 is now open! The class will run for a full week, June 12-18th, 2010. This will be the third year of the IMC, which will be taught by a team of fantasy artists working right alongside the students, and I'll be privileged to join in the fun this time.To register for enrollment, please visit the Illustration Master Classwebsite.Group photo courtesy Tor art director and bloggerIrene Gallo, who will be covering the event.
